title: AIR CONDITIONING-TUBE SHIELD
summary: Air-conditioned cars (C60): a sheet shield riveted to the front fender skirt (inner fender) covering the receiver-dehydrator tube where it passes through the skirt, near the front suspension. The skirt gets dimpled slots for the tube and four drilled holes for the rivets.

fastening.note: Shield [1] is riveted to the skirt with rivets [2] through 4 holes drilled 7/32 +0 -1/64 at dimple marks; rivets go in from the engine side and wheelhouse side as drawn.

notes_internal: Item 1: hole punch clips the tops of the first two digits; the remaining shapes read 39 clearly enough, not marked uncertain.
Slot dimensions written "125 X 3.30" and "150 X 2.80" (leading decimal point implied, printed as L25/L50 in hand lettering); recorded as .125/.150.
Rivet direction from the drawing is approximate; two [2] callouts on opposite sides of the skirt.
